description: T1 item 10, shared by both partitions: README.md (what the block is, its spec table, how to reproduce every result), sim/README.md, docs/environment-setup.md, LICENSE and the PDK-free CI workflow, plus the hermetic self-checks that workflow runs. The checks attest that the harness (its unit tests), the Python sources, the markdown links and the characterization-summary citations are valid on this tree. They deliberately exclude every CI check that reads the committed signoff verdict (the README status-table check, the remaining unit tests, signoff/run_signoff.py --check): those would be circular for an envelope the verdict itself cites, and CI runs them on every pull request anyway. They do not attest that a CI run is green, which is read off the pull request.
